description:
Calm local notes and shopping lists with watercolor-inspired design
AquarellNotes is a calm, local-first app for notes and shopping lists.

It is built for fast everyday capture without accounts, ads, analytics, tracking, or cloud dependencies. Notes use soft watercolor-style cards, while shopping lists stay practical and easy to scan.

Features:

* Create, edit, pin, color, delete, and share notes.
* Filter notes by color category.
* Sort notes by date, color, or alphabet.
* Create multiple named shopping lists.
* Add, edit, check off, delete, reset, clear, duplicate, and share shopping list items.
* Import shared shopping lists from WhatsApp text or AquarellNotes import links.
* Search notes and shopping items.
* Switch between list and detail views.
* Choose light, dark, or high-contrast appearance.
* Use German, English, or the Android system language.

All app data is stored locally on the device with Room.
